title: Restore Staging Gateway governance authority after schema-only recovery

phases.objective: Replay only the exact Staging Activation Gateway governance authority rows after schema-only local database recovery while preserving pending certification and all provider/Production boundaries.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Recover-StagingDatabases.ps1 on an exact clean main checkout after role-aware schema import
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The exact profile-owned Staging Gateway authority requirement, route, apply policy and Worker resource binding exist in Governance DB; dispatch certification remains pending and disabled; grant reconciliation then proceeds without any provider or Production mutation.
steps: Build and import the role-aware schema-only Staging bundles using the existing recovery lifecycle.
Validate the dedicated governance authority seed manifest, seed checksum, local Docker target, exact source SHA and required Governance tables before seed mutation.
Replay five idempotent Governance rows with local database root and perform exact same-cycle readback for authority identity, policy hash, resource binding and pending certification.
Continue existing role grant reconciliation only after the authority seed readback passes; Cloudflare, DNS, custom-domain and Production mutations remain forbidden.
assertions: The profile binding 5a2b04f8-bb99-4f65-a924-0f55d3080376 is restored by the canonical recovery path rather than by manual raw SQL.
The Staging apply policy remains bound to admin_cloudflare_v1, activation_gateway.staging_apply and the exact policy hash.
runtime_dispatch_certification_registry remains pending with dispatch_allowed=0 and apply_allowed=0 until independent same-cycle certification.
The seed contains no GRANT, REVOKE, user/database DDL, external-data SQL, provider call or secret payload.
The Governance seed SQL is pinned to LF in .gitattributes so the reviewed SHA-256 is stable on Windows checkout.
